description:
Buy 1000 basic data reads for US$1, valid for 30 days.
Same pass in retries recovers the same purchase. No automatic renewal. OCR, AI, documents and delivery keep their own tariffs. Send X-API-Pass on eligible data reads; remaining credits come in X-API-Credits-Remaining. With prepaid credit, you can skip this purchase: send X-Credito (or Authorization: Bearer cred_…) on the data read, and after the free allowance the origin buys these packages from the credit, one at a time.

api_pass.description: Private pass: api_<32 random hex>_<64 random hex>. Save before buying.

credit_token.description: Existing prepaid credit token; alternative to x402.

payment.description: Signed x402 authorization from the 402 quote, maximum 16 KiB.

transaction.description: Confirmed Base transaction hash for reconciliation with the original pass and signed payment. Never creates another charge.
